duplicate_policy.conflicting_label_duplicate: retain every source-test row in test; exclude matching source-train rows; exclude conflicting source-train-only groups from model splits; preserve and list all source paths
duplicate_policy.hash: SHA-256 of the grayscale 48x48 pixels used by the models
duplicate_policy.same_label_source_train_duplicates: keep all rows in one split group
duplicate_policy.train_and_source_test_duplicate: keep source-test rows in test; exclude source-train copies
duplicate_policy.unreadable_or_unsupported: preserve the source file and list it as excluded with a reason

split_settings.source_test: kept as supplied and excluded from model selection; unreadable or unsupported files remain listed as excluded
